TextBlock.Text: SOUTHERN PAPUA, last light. The relief corridor out of the enclave runs overland now, and the column has stopped twice today because the road is covered from a ridge nobody has cleared. A US package has been allocated for one evening: Apaches on the road, a Warthog pair on the ridge, a gunship on the loiter and a Strike Eagle section holding the long shots. A Polish F-16 detachment transiting to the theatre has been pulled in for escort. Get the column to the airhead. The gunship is only usable because nothing in this sector has a working radar - if the J-16D re-establishes the picture, it leaves.
Column: Get the relief column to the airhead Gunship: Do not lose the gunship Village: Leave the settlements alone
Two AH-64E, an A-10C, an AC-130J, two F-15E, a Polish F-16C, a B-2 on a single allocated pass. Opposing: a J-16D, PLA road detachments and a mobile SAM.

AH-64 Apache, A-10C, Lockheed AC-130 Pack, F-15E StrikeEagle, F-16C Fighting Falcon (modern), B-2 Spirit, French Army Vehicles, RE-power: the resupply mod, PLA Land Unit Pack, Shenyang J-16A (歼-16A 潜龙), Buildings and Targets for Missions, Pickup truck extension.
